title: writer hook: immutable decisions joined to measured cost revisions (PAPER / shadow only)

AI-SCAN-02.refresh_rule: set to the accepted merge SHA before freeze or implementation; never pin a superseded review head (R8)

ML-PAIR-01.refresh_rule: set to the accepted merge SHA before freeze or implementation; never pin a superseded review head (R8)

hooks.fires: after the engine has decided a candidate (taken | skipped | pending), at every existing _ml_decision call in the scan loop, independent of ML_SHADOW
hooks.copies: detached deep copies built on the engine thread; the hook never keeps a reference to engine objects

hooks.fires: only when a shadow producer exists; this slice has none, so zero shadow rows are written
when a taken decision's lot closes and actual_costs.row_view(row).status == 'measured' and actual_costs.measured(row).complete
hooks.copies: a plain dict of the five COST_REV_FIELDS read from the closed row, plus rev = row['cost_rev']

hooks.fires: after cost_rev is bumped on a closed row that already reached a measured outcome and is still measured and complete

decision_id.on_lot: lot['ml_decision_id'] stamped at engine.Engine._ml_link when ML_SHADOW or AI_SCAN is exactly True (R1)
decision_id.decided_at_source: lot['ml_decided_at'] (the signal decided_at, UTC ISO) is stamped together with ml_decision_id at engine.Engine._ml_link; the lot dict is persisted with engine state and copied onto the closed history row, so both close hooks read signal_id + decided_at from in-memory lot / row data, never from disk on the trading thread; a lot or row with ml_decision_id but no ml_decided_at counts no_decided_at and makes only that signal / outcome ineligible with a named decision-time gap; an otherwise clean writer session stays clean; no hot-path disk backfill (Codex 6462613229 #1, D1)
decision_id.decided_at_form: UTC ISO-8601 with exactly six-digit microseconds and Z, e.g. 2026-10-28T08:00:00.000000Z; fold rejects and counts decided_at_mismatch when an outcome decided_at differs from its signal (D1)
decision_id.flag_independence: AI_SCAN works without ML_SHADOW and ML_SHADOW without AI_SCAN; neither feature is a prerequisite for the other (R1)

join.v1_note: record_key and order_field_in_key describe the accepted ai_scan v1 key (#222); schema-v2 measured outcomes use record_key_v2 (F1)
join.revert: A -> B -> A appends rev 0 / 1 / 2 and fold selects rev 2; the economic identity stays (signal_id, cost_revision_id), the record identity also carries the integer rev; fitting never consumes every revision (F1, F5)
join.latest: highest rev among a decision's measured revisions
join.read_side_conflict: fold never raises: a conflict found on read poisons only that signal (ineligible, counted conflicts) (U2)
join.runtime_net_basis_rule: the generic accepted ai_scan schema stays compatible (COST_BASES unchanged); the writer hook passes only net_basis measured, so booked / acknowledged / pending / incomplete never enter the measured outcome ledger (R2)

restatements.ai_scan: append every measured cost restatement, for audit
restatements.ml_pair_01: first measured close only in this milestone
restatements.before_training: a separate frozen ML-pair restatement policy must choose append-plus-latest-collapse or first-finalized revision; one trade is never silently multiplied into training rows (R3)

never_gates.mechanism: the engine-thread hook only builds a sealed record inside try/except and offers it to a bounded, non-blocking queue; a dedicated writer daemon thread owns the scan ledger and does every disk write

queue.full: drop, count queue_full and open a durable health gap

writer_thread.isolation: a dedicated bounded AI-SCAN writer; its failures and lifecycle never touch the ml_shadow LedgerWriter (R5)

never_gates.exceptions: every exception in the hook or the writer is counted and swallowed; none reaches order flow
never_gates.flag_read: S.get('AI_SCAN') is True, read at each call; anything else is off

paper_only.live_check: engine.live is True -> refused before any record is built; counted refused_live

identity.gate: same rule as ML-PAIR-01 identity_gap: non-dev build_id, 40-hex source_commit from the matching build.json, 64-hex bundle_hash
identity.schema_bump: ai-scan-schema-v2 (record_hash covers code), made before the first runtime write; no v1 runtime producer exists
identity.content_hash: sha256 over the record excluding only code and record_hash (F2)
identity.cross_build_replay: same v2 key and same content_hash with a different code is replays_other_build and a no-op; a different content_hash is a conflict (F2)
identity.fit_identity: the signal code and the selected outcome code must each be complete but need not match, because a position may span an upgrade; both identities are kept in provenance (F2)

identity_upgrade_record.upgrade_content_hash: sha256 over (orig_record_hash, the original content_hash, the complete code identity), excluding the transport fields writer_id, seq, event_at and record_hash (U1)
identity_upgrade_record.exact_replay: same key and same upgrade_content_hash: no-op across sessions, even when transport fields differ
identity_upgrade_record.conflict: same orig_record_hash with a different original content_hash or a different complete code: conflict, counted conflicts
identity_upgrade_record.fold: applied only when the original record exists, its content_hash equals the upgrade content_hash, the original code is incomplete and the upgrade code is complete; otherwise ignored and counted identity_upgrade_invalid; the original row is never rewritten (Codex 6462613229 #2). An upgrade whose original lies outside the current bounded page is unresolved_original, not invalid; it resolves only after verified manifest pagination finds the original or conclusively proves it absent (U2)

identity.identity_upgrade: never rewrite or silently bless an incomplete original row; a complete-identity replay with an equal economic payload may append an explicit identity_upgrade record referencing the original record_hash; fold uses it only when payload equality and the complete build identity validate; a payload mismatch is a conflict; audit keeps both; until an upgrade exists the signal stays ineligible (G6)
identity.per_record: complete code identity on every record; a once-written epoch is insufficient because one append-only ledger spans several installed builds (R4)

incomplete.signal: written with code_complete false; never eligible for fitting, calibration or pairing
incomplete.shadow: written with code_complete false; never verifies
incomplete.outcome: refused unwritten; counted identity_incomplete with identity_reason

failure_modes.effect: hook returns before building anything; ledger untouched
record dropped; a durable health gap is opened; trading unaffected
writer output blocks until the pending gap is durable; trading unaffected
implicit open-ended gap from the last durable event to the next writer's first event
clean close to next start, or a disabled / flag-off / manifest-invalid / startup-failed / stopped interval, is a gap; windows crossing it are ineligible
explicit upgrade record appended; the original row is unchanged
that signal / outcome ineligible with a named decision-time gap; the session stays clean
outcome rejected on fold; the signal is ineligible
upgrade unresolved until verified pagination resolves it
any fit / calibration window crossing a gap is ineligible, never silently complete

rotation_prerequisite.rule: a runtime producer may not be enabled until bounded append-only segmentation / rotation plus manifest and replay semantics are implemented and tested; part of AI-SCAN-03 or a required predecessor, never post-producer cleanup (R6)
rotation_prerequisite.evidence: Cowork measured about 1.06 s to fold 20k duplicate rows
rotation_prerequisite.enable_check: a hash-valid manifest and a configured segment bound, verified at startup and on every hook call (F4)
rotation_prerequisite.on_mismatch: the producer is disabled and counted producer_disabled; it never appends on
rotation_prerequisite.hot_path: the per-hook check reads one atomic cached eligibility generation only: no disk I/O, hashing or manifest traversal on the trading thread; startup / writer-side refresh verifies manifest, hash and config and atomically publishes the generation (G4)
rotation_prerequisite.segment_bound: a positive integer within frozen byte / segment limits, never a truthy flag

limits.basis: Cowork measured ~1.06 s to fold 20k rows; a 16 MiB segment holds roughly 10k rows, so one segment folds in about 0.5 s and a 4-segment bounded read stays near 64 MiB (Codex 6462613229 #5)

rotation_prerequisite.manifest_full: at 4096 manifest segments the producer disables before append and records producer_disabled / manifest_full (L1)
rotation_prerequisite.pagination: a window needing more than 4 segments is processed only by verified manifest pagination: each read <= 4 segments with hash-chain / cursor continuity; any missing or changed page makes the window incomplete; the UI / API never returns a plausible partial row (L1)
rotation_prerequisite.pagination_terminal: the reader binds the expected page count, terminal cursor and final manifest end hash from the verified manifest before reading; a valid truncated prefix, a missing middle page or a missing final page is incomplete (Codex 6463297130 #3)
rotation_prerequisite.measurement: before runtime implementation, measure representative serialized signal / outcome / upgrade rows and record fold latency and resource evidence; the confirmed byte / count limits remain conservative v1 caps (L1)
rotation_prerequisite.read_path: the API reads manifest-bounded segments within a hard byte / segment bound and shows only causally complete views; when completeness cannot be proven it returns a bounded incomplete / error result, never a partial plausible row

queue_gaps.record: every queue_full drop opens or extends a durable gap {writer_id, from, to, dropped} written by the writer thread, outside the hot path
queue_gaps.bounds: inclusive UTC event_at; every queued envelope carries event_at (F3)
queue_gaps.pending: a drop sets a pending gap that is retried and flushed before any later record
queue_gaps.flush_failure: a failed gap flush blocks writer output, never trading
queue_gaps.writer_session: writer_id plus monotonic seq on every record, with manifest start and clean-close markers
queue_gaps.missing_clean_close: an implicit open-ended gap from the last durable event through the next writer's first event
queue_gaps.window_axis: training / calibration membership is keyed to the owning signal decided_at, never an outcome closed_at (G1)
queue_gaps.outcome_envelope: every queued outcome carries signal_id and the owning decided_at; a dropped outcome opens a gap against that signal and decision time, and the owning signal is ineligible even when its close lies outside the fit window
queue_gaps.unprovable_ownership: if a dropped record's owning signal cannot be proven, the affected writer session is conservatively incomplete; a lot that only lacks ml_decided_at is signal-scoped (D1)
queue_gaps.coverage: every interval from one durable clean close to the next durable start is a coverage gap; producer_disabled, flag-off, manifest-invalid, startup-failed and stopped intervals are gaps, not counters only; a zero-event interval is eligible only when an enabled writer session durably covers it (G2)
queue_gaps.sequence: monotonic seq allocated at the enqueue attempt, before the non-blocking offer; a drop consumes a seq and records it with the owning signal / decision context in the pending gap (G3)
queue_gaps.clean_close: forbidden until the queue is drained and no pending or unflushed gap exists
queue_gaps.window_interval: windows are half-open [start, end): decided_at == end belongs to the next window only (Codex 6462613229 #4)
queue_gaps.endcaps: the manifest records every session start, clean close, disable marker and periodic heartbeat (at most 60 s apart while enabled); time before the first durable start, after the last clean close, and after an open session's last durable heartbeat is uncovered; a window is eligible only when its whole [start, end) is continuously covered by clean enabled sessions or an open session up to its last heartbeat (Codex 6462613229 #3)
queue_gaps.inferred_gaps: flag-off, startup-failed and stopped intervals need no record of their own: any time not inside a covered span is a gap; producer_disabled and manifest-invalid write an explicit disable marker that ends coverage
queue_gaps.heartbeat: emitted on a monotonic 60 s schedule and persisted with strictly increasing UTC timestamps; coverage is the union of consecutive half-open heartbeat spans whose wall-time gap is at most 75 s (60 + 15 tolerance); a larger gap is an uncovered hole; a backward or non-increasing UTC step ends trustworthy coverage and opens a hole until a new durable session starts (C1)
queue_gaps.eligibility: a window is eligible only when _covered([start, end)) holds continuously over the whole window; checking only the signal timestamp is forbidden; session and heartbeat spans are half-open [a, b) (C2); coverage spans are derived from heartbeats (C1), never from clean start / close alone, so a clean-close session with a heartbeat hole fails whole-window eligibility (Codex 6463297130 #2)
queue_gaps.start_marker: durable before the first accepted record; a start-write failure disables the session and makes it unclean
queue_gaps.window_rule: any downstream fit or calibration window that crosses a gap is ineligible, never silently complete (R7)

test_plan.name: test_flag_off_builds_and_writes_nothing
test_plan.asserts: AI_SCAN False: no hook builds a record, the ledger file is not created, counters stay zero

test_plan.name: test_live_mode_refused_before_build
test_plan.asserts: engine.live True with AI_SCAN True: refused_live counts, nothing built or written

test_plan.name: test_trading_byte_identical_with_ai_scan_on_off_and_failing_writer
test_plan.asserts: the same replayed PAPER cycle with AI_SCAN off, on, on with a raising writer, and on with a full queue yields byte-identical orders, history, state and log of order calls

test_plan.name: test_hook_never_raises_into_order_flow
test_plan.asserts: every builder and writer exception is counted in build_errors / write_errors and the cycle completes

test_plan.name: test_offer_never_blocks_when_queue_full_or_contended
test_plan.asserts: offer returns False within a bound; queue_full counts

test_plan.name: test_writer_never_holds_engine_lock
test_plan.asserts: the engine lock stays acquirable by the cycle while the writer is blocked on disk

test_plan.name: test_decision_hook_writes_one_signal_per_candidate
test_plan.asserts: each _ml_decision call yields one signal whose signal_id equals ml_shadow.ledger.decision_id, with or without ML_SHADOW

test_plan.name: test_measured_close_appends_outcome_keyed_by_cost_revision
test_plan.asserts: a measured, complete close of a taken decision appends one outcome with cost_revision_id computed from the payload and rev = cost_rev

test_plan.name: test_restatement_appends_new_revision_never_rewrites
test_plan.asserts: a _row_changed restatement appends a second outcome; the first line is byte-unchanged; fold picks the highest rev

test_plan.name: test_restart_replay_is_idempotent
test_plan.asserts: re-offering every record after a restart writes nothing and counts replays

test_plan.name: test_conflicting_replay_refused_unwritten
test_plan.asserts: same record key, different record_hash: refused, conflicts counts, file bytes unchanged

test_plan.name: test_same_rev_two_costs_refused
test_plan.asserts: two cost revisions sharing one rev: the second is refused and counted ambiguous_rev

test_plan.name: test_booked_acknowledged_pending_never_measured
test_plan.asserts: booked, acknowledged, pending and incomplete closes produce no outcome and count non_measured_close / cost_incomplete

test_plan.name: test_outcome_only_for_taken_decisions
test_plan.asserts: skipped and pending decisions get no measured outcome; not_taken counts

test_plan.name: test_incomplete_identity_refuses_outcome_flags_signal
test_plan.asserts: dev build, missing source_commit or bundle_hash: outcome refused with identity_reason, signal written with code_complete false

test_plan.name: test_cost_identity_matches_ml_pair_01
test_plan.asserts: for the same close, ai_scan cost_revision_id equals ml_shadow.pairs cost_revision_id and signal_id equals the pair decision_id (enabled once #226 merges)

test_plan.name: test_no_model_or_network_call
test_plan.asserts: with sockets and the anthropic client patched to raise, every hook path completes and nothing is called

test_plan.name: test_flags_independent_either_flag_stamps_decision_id
test_plan.asserts: AI_SCAN on with ML_SHADOW off (and the reverse) stamps lot['ml_decision_id']; neither flag requires the other

test_plan.name: test_writer_thread_isolated_from_ml_shadow
test_plan.asserts: a raising or stopped ml_shadow LedgerWriter leaves the AI-SCAN writer running, and the reverse

test_plan.name: test_every_record_carries_code_identity_schema_v2
test_plan.asserts: signal, shadow and outcome records carry code and schema ai-scan-schema-v2; record_hash covers code

test_plan.name: test_rotation_segments_manifest_and_replay
test_plan.asserts: segments stay bounded and append-only, the manifest lists every segment hash, replay across segments is idempotent

test_plan.name: test_producer_enable_refused_without_rotation
test_plan.asserts: enabling the runtime producer without the rotation prerequisite is refused

test_plan.name: test_queue_drop_opens_durable_gap_and_window_ineligible
test_plan.asserts: a full queue writes a durable gap; a fit / calibration window crossing it is ineligible

test_plan.name: test_v2_restatement_revert_appends_and_latest_is_rev2
test_plan.asserts: A -> B -> A appends rev 0 / 1 / 2 under the v2 key and fold selects rev 2 (costs A); same key + different content is a conflict

test_plan.name: test_other_build_replay_is_noop_not_conflict
test_plan.asserts: same v2 key and content_hash with a different code is counted replays_other_build and writes nothing; a different content_hash is a conflict

test_plan.name: test_drop_crash_restart_window_ineligible
test_plan.asserts: a queue drop, then a crash before the gap flush, then a restart: the missing clean close yields an implicit gap and the window crossing it is ineligible

test_plan.name: test_manifest_mismatch_disables_producer
test_plan.asserts: a missing or hash-invalid manifest, or no segment bound, refuses enable at startup and on a hook call; counted producer_disabled

test_plan.name: test_api_view_bounded_and_causally_complete
test_plan.asserts: the API reads manifest-bounded segments within a hard byte / segment bound and returns a bounded incomplete / error result, never a partial plausible row

test_plan.name: test_one_trade_one_training_row
test_plan.asserts: fitting is refused while the ML restatement policy is unfrozen; afterwards one trade with three revisions yields exactly one training row, and an invalid latest revision yields zero rows (no fallback)

test_plan.name: test_dropped_outcome_makes_owning_signal_ineligible_by_decided_at
test_plan.asserts: a dropped outcome whose closed_at lies outside the fit window still makes its owning signal (keyed by decided_at) ineligible; unprovable ownership makes the writer session incomplete

test_plan.name: test_uncovered_and_disabled_intervals_are_gaps
test_plan.asserts: clean close to next durable start, producer_disabled, flag-off, manifest-invalid, startup-failed and stopped intervals are gaps; a window crossing one is ineligible; a zero-event interval covered by an enabled session is eligible

test_plan.name: test_sequence_allocated_at_enqueue_and_drop_records_it
test_plan.asserts: seq is allocated at the enqueue attempt before the offer; a drop consumes a seq and the pending gap records it with the owning signal / decision context

test_plan.name: test_clean_close_forbidden_with_pending_gap
test_plan.asserts: no clean-close marker until the queue is drained and no pending / unflushed gap exists; a failed start marker disables the session and makes it unclean

test_plan.name: test_hook_reads_cached_generation_only
test_plan.asserts: the per-hook check reads one atomic cached eligibility generation: no disk I/O, hashing or manifest traversal on the trading thread; segment_bound must be a positive integer within frozen limits

test_plan.name: test_invalid_latest_revision_excludes_signal_no_fallback
test_plan.asserts: the highest rev is selected first; if it is identity- or cost-incomplete the signal is excluded and no older valid revision is used

test_plan.name: test_identity_upgrade_record_and_conflict
test_plan.asserts: a complete-identity replay with an equal economic payload appends identity_upgrade referencing the original record hash and fold may use it; a payload mismatch is a conflict; the original row is never rewritten

test_plan.name: test_close_hooks_carry_owning_decided_at_from_the_lot
test_plan.asserts: measured_close and cost_restatement payloads carry signal_id and decided_at read from the in-memory lot / closed row (stamped at _ml_link), never from disk on the trading thread; a missing decided_at makes only that signal / outcome ineligible and the session stays clean (D1)

test_plan.name: test_identity_upgrade_v2_replay_conflict_and_fold
test_plan.asserts: identity_upgrade v2 key (kind, orig_record_hash): exact replay is a no-op, same key with a different record_hash is a conflict, fold applies it only when the original exists, content hashes match and the upgrade code is complete

test_plan.name: test_window_requires_continuous_coverage_including_endcaps
test_plan.asserts: a [start, end) window is eligible only when clean enabled sessions (or an open session up to its last durable heartbeat) cover it continuously; before the first start and after the last close / heartbeat are uncovered

test_plan.name: test_window_boundary_is_half_open
test_plan.asserts: a signal with decided_at == end belongs to the next window only; no double membership

test_plan.name: test_segment_bound_numeric_limits
test_plan.asserts: segment_bytes outside [min, max] or more than max_segments_per_read segments refuse; a truthy non-integer refuses

test_plan.name: test_upgrade_replay_with_changed_transport_is_noop
test_plan.asserts: an identity_upgrade replayed by another session (different writer_id / seq / event_at / record_hash, same upgrade_content_hash) is a no-op; a different original content_hash or a different complete code is a conflict

test_plan.name: test_read_side_conflict_poisons_signal_never_raises
test_plan.asserts: a fold-side conflict marks only that signal ineligible and counts conflicts; fold never raises

test_plan.name: test_upgrade_with_original_outside_page_is_unresolved
test_plan.asserts: an upgrade whose original is outside the current bounded page is unresolved_original, not invalid; it resolves only after verified pagination finds the original or proves it absent

test_plan.name: test_heartbeat_hole_over_75s_and_backward_step
test_plan.asserts: heartbeat spans cover only consecutive gaps <= 75 s; a 10-minute mid-session hole and a non-increasing UTC step are uncovered until a new durable session starts

test_plan.name: test_whole_window_eligibility_and_t_equals_close
test_plan.asserts: eligibility requires continuous heartbeat-derived coverage of the whole [start, end) window; a covered signal inside a partly uncovered window is ineligible; a clean-close session with a 10-minute heartbeat hole fails; t == close is outside the half-open span

test_plan.name: test_missing_or_mismatched_decided_at_is_signal_scoped
test_plan.asserts: a missing ml_decided_at makes only that signal / outcome ineligible with a named decision-time gap; the session stays clean; a signal / outcome decided_at mismatch is rejected and counted; canonical form is fixed 6-digit microseconds with Z

test_plan.name: test_manifest_full_disables_before_append_and_pagination_continuity
test_plan.asserts: at 4096 manifest segments the producer disables before append (producer_disabled / manifest_full); multi-page reads of <= 4 segments need hash-chain / cursor continuity and must reach the bound terminal cursor / page count / end hash; a truncated prefix, missing middle page or missing final page makes the window incomplete

test_plan.name: test_api_view_unchanged_shape
test_plan.asserts: GET /api/ai_scan returns ai_scan.api_off() when off and only ledger rows when on; no settings or engine state mutated

fitting.before_policy_frozen: no fitting or calibration consumer may use AI-SCAN rows until the separate ML restatement policy is frozen (F5)
fitting.after: exactly one latest valid measured revision per signal_id, after gap and code checks
fitting.latest_rule: select the highest rev first; if it is identity- or cost-incomplete the signal is excluded; never fall back to an older valid revision (G5)

rulings_f.F1_revert: option (a): integer rev is in the schema-v2 measured record key
rulings_f.F2_cross_build: content_hash excludes only code and record_hash; other-build replay is a no-op; code identities each complete, need not match
rulings_f.F3_gaps: event_at timebase, inclusive UTC bounds, pending gap flushed before later records, writer_id + seq + clean-close markers, no cross-writer merge
rulings_f.F4_rotation: live manifest / segment-bound check at startup and every hook; mismatch disables; causally complete bounded API reads
rulings_f.F5_fitting: no fitting before the ML restatement policy is frozen; then one latest valid revision per signal_id

rulings_g.G1_window_axis: membership keyed to the owning signal decided_at; a dropped outcome makes its signal ineligible
rulings_g.G2_coverage: clean close to next start and every disabled / failed / stopped interval is a gap
rulings_g.G3_sequence: seq at enqueue attempt; no clean close with a pending gap; durable start marker first
rulings_g.G4_hot_path: cached atomic eligibility generation only; segment_bound a positive integer within frozen limits
rulings_g.G5_latest: highest rev first; an invalid latest excludes the signal, no fallback
rulings_g.G6_identity_upgrade: explicit identity_upgrade record on equal payload; mismatch is a conflict; never rewrite

rulings_h.H1_decided_at_source: lot ml_decided_at stamped at _ml_link; both close hooks carry signal_id + decided_at from memory
rulings_h.H2_identity_upgrade_schema: explicit v2 identity_upgrade kind, fields, key, replay / conflict and fold rule
rulings_h.H3_coverage_endcaps: manifest start / close / disable / heartbeat markers; continuous [start, end) coverage required
rulings_h.H5_numeric_limits: 1 MiB <= segment <= 16 MiB, at most 4 segments per read, at most 4096 manifest segments

rulings_u.U1_semantic_upgrade_replay: upgrade_content_hash excludes transport fields; replay across sessions is a no-op
rulings_u.U2_bounded_fold: read-side conflict poisons only that signal; original outside page is unresolved_original
rulings_u.C1_heartbeat: monotonic 60 s schedule, strictly increasing UTC, gaps > 75 s and backward steps are holes
rulings_u.C2_whole_window: eligibility needs continuous [start, end) coverage; spans are half-open
rulings_u.D1_decided_at: missing decided_at is signal-scoped; canonical 6-digit microseconds Z; mismatch counted
rulings_u.L1_bounded_reader: measure rows before runtime; manifest_full disables before append; verified pagination of <= 4 segments

rulings.R1_independent_flags: AI_SCAN works without ML_SHADOW; stamp the shared decision id when either flag is exactly true; neither is a prerequisite for the other
rulings.R2_measured_only_runtime: generic ai_scan schema stays compatible; the writer hook passes only net_basis measured
rulings.R3_restatements: AI-SCAN appends every measured restatement; ML-PAIR-01 stays first-measured-close; a frozen ML-pair restatement policy is required before training
rulings.R4_identity: ai-scan-schema-v2 with complete code identity on each record, bumped before first write
rulings.R5_writer_isolation: dedicated bounded AI-SCAN writer thread, one per ledger, started when AI_SCAN is enabled, not coupled to ML_SHADOW
rulings.R6_rotation_prerequisite: bounded append-only segmentation / rotation with manifest and replay semantics, implemented and tested before any runtime producer is enabled
rulings.R7_queue_gaps: queue-full / drop counters surface a durable health gap; windows crossing a gap are ineligible
rulings.R8_builds_on: refresh builds_on to the accepted merge SHAs of #222 / #226 before freeze or implementation
